systems.name: Ripple
systems.description: Svelte 5 generative-UI runtime (@ripple-ui/svelte). Renders declarative JSON specs (UISpec / UniversalSpec) into fully interactive UIs with reactive state, expression resolution, event dispatch, and ~240 widget types including marketing, premium, and motion packs.

containers.name: Ripple Runtime
containers.description: The publishable npm library (dist/). All components, the core engine, schema definitions, the widget registry, intent layouts, and the motion system. The SvelteKit routes (src/routes/) are a dev playground only.

components.name: Core Engine
components.description: Reactive state machine and rendering primitives. StateManager ($state rune, dot-path get/set), EventDispatcher (set/api/navigate/toast/emit/open/pin/unpin actions), ExpressionResolver ({state.path}, {item.field}, ternary, arithmetic), spec normalizer (UISpec→UniversalSpec), and NodeRenderer.svelte (recursive widget tree renderer with show-condition eval, loop context, prop binding). src/lib/core/ + src/lib/components/NodeRenderer.svelte + src/lib/Ripple.svelte.

components.name: Schema
components.description: Type contracts for the two spec systems: UISpec (explicit widget tree with UINode), UniversalSpec (intent-based high-level spec), FlowAction (chain-step action types), and WidgetTypes (widget type enum). src/lib/schema/.

components.name: Widget Registry
components.description: WidgetRegistry class plus ~240 widget types across layout, display, input, data, control, composite, overlay, research, vertical, workflow, interactive, and media categories. Build-time manifest for static-safe widget enumeration. src/lib/widgets/ + src/lib/manifest/.

components.name: Marketing + Premium Widgets
components.description: 50+ MIT-ported landing and marketing widgets (Hero, Cta, FeatureGrid, Footer, Faq, MarketingHero, Navbar, Testimonial, LogoCloud, Newsletter) and premium animated widgets (Marquee, BorderBeam, AnimatedBeam, Aurora, Spotlight, BentoGrid, TextEffect, Shimmer). src/lib/widgets/marketing/ + src/lib/widgets/premium/.

components.name: Intent System
components.description: High-level intent rendering: IntentRenderer.svelte dispatches to LayoutEngine (auto-selects layout from intent type and data shape), PatternDetector (identifies quiz/results patterns), and 14 named intent layouts (FormLayout, SummaryLayout, DetailLayout, SelectLayout, TableLayout, etc.). Falls back to NodeRenderer for 'custom' intent. src/lib/intent/.

components.name: Dashboard Renderer
components.description: Muuri-backed draggable grid renderer for dashboard intents. DashboardRenderer.svelte manages slot registration, drag-and-drop reorder, and resize events. dashboard-manager.svelte.ts holds the reactive grid state. src/lib/intent/DashboardRenderer.svelte + src/lib/intent/dashboard-manager.svelte.ts.

components.name: Chain Flow
components.description: Client-side multi-step flow engine (RFC 13). ChainExecutor (chain-executor.svelte.ts) walks nested chain/chain_map UniversalSpec trees with zero round-trips, accumulating per-step data, enforcing required-field gates, and maintaining back/forward history. FlowRunner.svelte is the host component. src/lib/intent/chain-executor.svelte.ts + src/lib/intent/FlowRunner.svelte.

components.name: Motion System
components.description: Declarative node-level animation (RFC 12). Motion engine (src/lib/motion/engine.ts) resolves animation presets and applies them. with-motion.ts Svelte action (src/lib/actions/with-motion.ts) attaches motion to rendered nodes. Reveal and Parallax sugar widgets desugar to motion fields. Supports reduced-motion via prefers-reduced-motion.

systems.name: paw-enterprise
systems.description: External: SvelteKit frontend that consumes ripple as @ripple-ui/svelte (file: dep). Renders pocket UIs and admin surfaces via the Ripple runtime.

systems.name: PocketPaw
systems.description: External: agentic OS backend. Pockets produce rippleSpec JSON; the cloud site engine compiles the ripple track for static/dynamic Paw Sites.
